LEFT JOIN threshold_runs t50 ON mfr.player_id = t50.player_id
LEFT JOIN threshold_runs t100 ON mfr.player_id = t100.player_id
LEFT JOIN balls_faced bf ON mfr.player_id = bf.player_id
LEFT JOIN wickets_taken wt ON mfr.player_id = wt.player_id
LEFT JOIN economy_calc ec ON mfr.player_id = ec.player_id
LEFT JOIN best_bowling bbm ON mfr.player_id = bbm.player_id
ORDER BY player_id

WITH monthly_changes AS (
    SELECT 
        customer_id,
        SUBSTR(txn_date, 1, 7) as month_str,
        SUM(CASE 
            WHEN txn_type = 'deposit' THEN txn_amount 
            WHEN txn_type = 'withdrawal' THEN -txn_amount 
            WHEN txn_type = 'purchase' THEN -txn_amount 
            ELSE 0 
        END) as net_change
    FROM customer_transactions
    GROUP BY customer_id, SUBSTR(txn_date, 1, 7)
),
all_months AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT month_str FROM monthly_changes
),
customer_month_combos AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT cm.customer_id, am.month_str
    FROM all_months am
    CROSS JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT customer_id FROM monthly_changes) cm
)
SELECT 
    cmc.customer_id,
    cmc.month_str,
    COALESCE(mc.net_change, 0) as monthly_change,
    SUM(COALESCE(mc.net_change, 0)) OVER (
        PARTITION BY cmc.customer_id 
        ORDER BY cmc.month_str 
        ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW
    ) as cumulative_balance
FROM customer_month_combos cmc
LEFT JOIN monthly_changes mc ON cmc.customer_id = mc.customer_id AND cmc.month_str = mc.month_str
ORDER BY cmc.customer_id, cmc.month_str

<parameter=sql>
WITH purchasing_cookies AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT cookie_id
    FROM shopping_cart_events
    WHERE event_type = 3
),
product_views AS (
    SELECT 
        ph.product_id,
        se.cookie_id,
        COUNT(*) as views
    FROM shopping_cart_events se
    JOIN shopping_cart_page_hierarchy ph ON se.page_id = ph.page_id
    WHERE se.event_type = 1
    AND se.page_id NOT IN (1, 2, 12, 13)
    GROUP BY ph.product_id, se.cookie_id
),
cart_additions AS (
    SELECT 
        ph.product_id,
        se.cookie_id,
        COUNT(*) as cart_additions
    FROM shopping_cart_events se
    JOIN shopping_cart_page_hierarchy ph ON se.page_id = ph.page_id
    WHERE se.event_type = 2
    AND se.page_id NOT IN (1, 2, 12, 13)
    GROUP BY ph.product_id, se.cookie_id
),
purchased_products AS (
    SELECT 
        pv.product_id,
        pv.cookie_id,
        pv.views
    FROM product_views pv
    JOIN purchasing_cookies pc ON pv.cookie_id = pc.cookie_id
),
cart_but_not_purchased AS (
    SELECT 
        ca.product_id,
        ca.cookie_id,
        ca.cart_additions
    FROM cart_additions ca
    LEFT JOIN product_views pv ON ca.cookie_id = pv.cookie_id AND ca.product_id = pv.product_id
    LEFT JOIN purchasing_cookies pc ON ca.cookie_id = pc.cookie_id
    WHERE pc.cookie_id IS NULL
)
SELECT 
    pp.product_id,
    pp.views,
    COALESCE(nb.cart_additions, 0) as cart_additions,
    COALESCE(nb.cart_additions - pp.views, 0) as left_in_cart,
    pp.views AS purchases
FROM purchased_products pp
LEFT JOIN cart_but_not_purchased nb ON pp.product_id = nb.product_id
GROUP BY pp.product_id
ORDER BY pp.product_id
</parameter>

</parameter>

WITH product_events AS (
    SELECT 
        ph.product_id,
        sh.event_type,
        COUNT(*) as event_count
    FROM shopping_cart_events sh
    JOIN shopping_cart_page_hierarchy ph ON sh.page_id = ph.page_id
    WHERE sh.page_id NOT IN (1, 2, 12, 13)
    GROUP BY ph.product_id, sh.event_type
)
SELECT 
    product_id,
    SUM(CASE WHEN event_type = 1 THEN event_count ELSE 0 END) as page_views,
    SUM(CASE WHEN event_type = 2 THEN event_count ELSE 0 END) as added_to_cart,
    SUM(CASE WHEN event_type = 3 THEN event_count ELSE 0 END) as purchases,
    SUM(CASE WHEN event_type = 2 THEN event_count ELSE 0 END) - SUM(CASE WHEN event_type = 3 THEN event_count ELSE 0 END) as left_in_cart
FROM product_events
GROUP BY product_id
ORDER BY product_id

WITH page_to_product AS (
    SELECT page_id, product_id
    FROM shopping_cart_page_hierarchy
    WHERE page_id NOT IN (1, 2, 12, 13)
),
event_counts AS (
    SELECT 
        p.page_id,
        p.product_id,
        e.event_type,
        COUNT(*) as event_count
    FROM shopping_cart_events e
    JOIN page_to_product p ON e.page_id = p.page_id
    WHERE e.event_type IN (1, 2, 3)
    GROUP BY p.page_id, p.product_id, e.event_type
)
SELECT 
    product_id,
    SUM(CASE WHEN event_type = 1 THEN event_count ELSE 0 END) as views,
    SUM(CASE WHEN event_type = 2 THEN event_count ELSE 0 END) as cart_additions,
    SUM(CASE WHEN event_type = 3 THEN event_count ELSE 0 END) as purchases,
    SUM(CASE WHEN event_type = 2 THEN event_count ELSE 0 END) - SUM(CASE WHEN event_type = 3 THEN event_count ELSE 0 END) as left_in_cart_without_purchase
FROM event_counts
GROUP BY product_id
ORDER BY product_id

local077.question: Please analyze our interest data from September 2018 to August 2019. For each month, calculate the average composition for each interest by dividing the composition by the index value. Identify the interest with the highest average composition value each month and report its average composition as the max index composition for that month. Compute the three-month rolling average of these monthly max index compositions. Ensure the output includes the date, the interest name, the max index composition for that month, the rolling average, and the names and max index compositions of the top interests from one month ago and two months ago.

candidates.sql:
WITH monthly_avg_composition AS (
  SELECT 
    month_year,
    interest_id,
    AVG(composition / index_value) as avg_composition
  FROM interest_metrics
  WHERE month_year IN ('09-2018','10-2018','11-2018','12-2018','01-2019','02-2019','03-2019','04-2019','05-2019','06-2019','07-2019','08-2019')
    AND month_year != ''
  GROUP BY month_year, interest_id
),
monthly_max_interest AS (
  SELECT 
    month_year,
    interest_id,
    avg_composition,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY month_year ORDER BY avg_composition DESC) as rn
  FROM monthly_avg_composition
),
monthly_top_interest AS (
  SELECT 
    month_year,
    interest_id,
    avg_composition as max_idx_composition
  FROM monthly_max_interest
  WHERE rn = 1
),
monthly_top_with_name AS (
  SELECT 
    mt.month_year,
    mt.interest_id,
    mt.max_idx_composition,
    im.interest_name
  FROM monthly_top_interest mt
  JOIN interest_map im ON mt.interest_id = im.id
  ORDER BY mt.month_year
),
final_result AS (
  SELECT 
    month_year as date,
    interest_name,
    max_idx_composition as max_index_composition,
    AVG(max_idx_composition) OVER (
      ORDER BY month_year 
      ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW
    ) as rolling_avg_3mo,
    LAG(interest_name, 1) OVER (ORDER BY month_year) as name_1mo_ago,
    LAG(max_idx_composition, 1) OVER (ORDER BY month_year) as max_idx_1mo_ago,
    LAG(interest_name, 2) OVER (ORDER BY month_year) as name_2mo_ago,
    LAG(max_idx_composition, 2) OVER (ORDER BY month_year) as max_idx_2mo_ago
  FROM monthly_top_with_name
)
SELECT * FROM final_result ORDER BY date

WITH monthly_avg_composition AS (
    SELECT 
        month_year,
        interest_id,
        AVG(composition / index_value) as avg_composition_ratio
    FROM interest_metrics
    WHERE month_year IN ('09-2018', '10-2018', '11-2018', '12-2018', '01-2019', '02-2019', '03-2019', '04-2019', '05-2019', '06-2019', '07-2019', '08-2019')
    GROUP BY month_year, interest_id
),
ranked_interests AS (
    SELECT 
        month_year,
        interest_id,
        avg_composition_ratio,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY month_year ORDER BY avg_composition_ratio DESC) as rn
    FROM monthly_avg_composition
),
max_monthly AS (
    SELECT 
        month_year,
        interest_id,
        avg_composition_ratio as max_composition_ratio
    FROM ranked_interests
    WHERE rn = 1
),
with_names AS (
    SELECT 
        m.month_year,
        im.interest_name,
        m.max_composition_ratio,
        CAST(SUBSTR(m.month_year, 6, 4) AS INTEGER) as yr,
        CAST(SUBSTR(m.month_year, 1, 2) AS INTEGER) as mo
    FROM max_monthly m
    JOIN interest_map im ON m.interest_id = im.id
),
with_lag1 AS (
    SELECT 
        month_year,
        interest_name,
        max_composition_ratio,
        yr,
        mo,
        LAG(max_composition_ratio) OVER (ORDER BY yr, mo) as prev_month_ratio,
        LAG(interest_name) OVER (ORDER BY yr, mo) as prev_month_interest_name
    FROM with_names
),
with_lag2 AS (
    SELECT 
        month_year,
        interest_name,
        max_composition_ratio,
        yr,
        mo,
        prev_month_ratio,
        prev_month_interest_name,
        LAG(prev_month_ratio) OVER (ORDER BY yr, mo) as prev2_month_ratio,
        LAG(prev_month_interest_name) OVER (ORDER BY yr, mo) as prev2_month_interest_name
    FROM with_lag1
),
with_rolling_avg AS (
    SELECT 
        month_year,
        interest_name,
        max_composition_ratio,
        ROUND(AVG(max_composition_ratio) OVER (ORDER BY yr, mo ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW), 6) as three_month_rolling_avg,
        prev_month_interest_name,
        prev_month_ratio,
        prev2_month_interest_name,
        prev2_month_ratio
    FROM with_lag2
)
SELECT 
    month_year as date,
    interest_name,
    max_composition_ratio,
    three_month_rolling_avg,
    prev_month_interest_name,
    prev_month_ratio,
    prev2_month_interest_name,
    prev2_month_ratio
FROM with_rolling_avg
ORDER BY CAST(SUBSTR(month_year, 6, 4) AS INTEGER), CAST(SUBSTR(month_year, 1, 2) AS INTEGER)

        month_year,
        interest_id,
        AVG(composition / index_value) as avg_composition_ratio
    FROM interest_metrics
    WHERE month_year IN ('09-2018', '10-2018', '11-2018', '12-2018', '01-2019', '02-2019', '03-2019', '04-2019', '05-2019', '06-2019', '07-2019', '08-2019')
    GROUP BY month_year, interest_id
),

    SELECT 
        month_year,
        interest_id,
        avg_composition_ratio,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY month_year ORDER BY avg_composition_ratio DESC) as rn
    FROM monthly_avg_composition
),
max_monthly AS (
    SELECT 
        month_year,
        interest_id,
        avg_composition_ratio as max_composition_ratio
    FROM ranked_interests
    WHERE rn = 1
),
with_names AS (
    SELECT 
        m.month_year,
        im.interest_name,
        m.max_composition_ratio,
        CAST(SUBSTR(m.month_year, 6, 4) AS INTEGER) as year,
        CAST(SUBSTR(m.month_year, 1, 2) AS INTEGER) as month
    FROM max_monthly m
    JOIN interest_map im ON m.interest_id = im.id
),
with_rollable_data AS (
    SELECT 
        month_year,
        interest_name,
        max_composition_ratio,
        year,
        month,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY year, month) as rn
    FROM with_names
),
with_lagged AS (
    SELECT 
        month_year,
        interest_name,
        max_composition_ratio,
        year,
        month,
        rn,
        LAG(max_composition_ratio, 1) OVER (ORDER BY year, month) as prev_max,
        LAG(max_composition_ratio, 2) OVER (ORDER BY year, month) as prev2_max,
        LAG(interest_name, 1) OVER (ORDER BY year, month) as prev_interest,
        LAG(interest_name, 2) OVER (ORDER BY year, month) as prev2_interest
    FROM with_rollable_data
)
SELECT 
    month_year,
    interest_name,
    max_composition_ratio,
    ROUND(AVG(max_composition_ratio) OVER (ORDER BY year, month ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW), 6) as rolling_avg_3m,
    prev_interest as interest_name_1_month_ago,
    prev_max as max_composition_ratio_1_month_ago,
    prev2_interest as interest_name_2_months_ago,

local156.question: Analyze the annual average purchase price per Bitcoin by region, computed as the total dollar amount spent divided by the total quantity purchased each year, excluding the first year's data for each region. Then, for each year, rank the regions based on these average purchase prices, and calculate the annual percentage change in cost for each region compared to the previous year.

candidates.sql:
WITH yearly_region_stats AS (
    SELECT 
        bm.region,
        SUBSTR(bt.txn_date, 7, 4) as txn_year,
        SUM(bt.quantity * bp.price) as total_spent,
        SUM(bt.quantity) as total_quantity
    FROM bitcoin_transactions bt
    JOIN bitcoin_members bm ON bt.member_id = bm.member_id
    JOIN bitcoin_prices bp ON bt.ticker = bp.ticker AND bt.txn_date = bp.market_date
    WHERE bt.ticker = 'BTC' 
        AND bt.txn_type = 'BUY'
        AND bm.region IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY bm.region, SUBSTR(bt.txn_date, 7, 4)
),
annual_avg_price AS (
    SELECT 
        region,
        txn_year,
        total_spent,
        total_quantity,
        (1.0 * total_spent / total_quantity) as avg_purchase_price
    FROM yearly_region_stats
    WHERE txn_year != '2017'
),
ranked_and_pct_change AS (
    SELECT 
        region,
        txn_year,
        avg_purchase_price,
        RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY txn_year ORDER BY avg_purchase_price DESC) as price_rank,
        LAG(avg_purchase_price) OVER (PARTITION BY region ORDER BY txn_year) as prev_year_price,
        (1.0 * (avg_purchase_price - LAG(avg_purchase_price) OVER (PARTITION BY region ORDER BY txn_year)) / 
         LAG(avg_purchase_price) OVER (PARTITION BY region ORDER BY txn_year)) * 100 as pct_change
    FROM annual_avg_price
)
SELECT 
    region,
    txn_year,
    ROUND(avg_purchase_price, 2) as avg_purchase_price,
    price_rank,
    ROUND(pct_change, 2) as pct_change
FROM ranked_and_pct_change
ORDER BY txn_year, price_rank

WITH buy_transactions AS (
    SELECT 
        m.region,
        substr(t.txn_date, 7, 4) as txn_year,
        t.quantity,
        p.price,
        t.quantity * p.price as dollar_amount
    FROM bitcoin_transactions t
    JOIN bitcoin_members m ON t.member_id = m.member_id
    JOIN bitcoin_prices p ON t.ticker = p.ticker
    WHERE t.txn_type = 'BUY'
        AND p.ticker = 'BTC'
        AND substr(t.txn_date, 7, 4) = substr(p.market_date, 7, 4)
),
yearly_totals AS (
    SELECT 
        region,
        txn_year,
        SUM(dollar_amount) as total_dollar_amount,
        SUM(quantity) as total_quantity
    FROM buy_transactions
    GROUP BY region, txn_year
),
first_year_by_region AS (
    SELECT 
        region,
        MIN(txn_year) as first_year
    FROM yearly_totals
    GROUP BY region
),
first_year_excluded AS (
    SELECT 
        yt.region,
        yt.txn_year,
        yt.total_dollar_amount,
        yt.total_quantity,
        (yt.total_dollar_amount * 1.0 / yt.total_quantity) as avg_purchase_price
    FROM yearly_totals yt
    WHERE yt.txn_year != (SELECT first_year FROM first_year_by_region WHERE first_year_by_region.region = yt.region)
),
ranked AS (
    SELECT 
        region,
        txn_year,
        avg_purchase_price,
        RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY txn_year ORDER BY avg_purchase_price DESC) as price_rank
    FROM first_year_excluded
),
with_pct_change AS (
    SELECT 
        region,
        txn_year,
        avg_purchase_price,
        price_rank,
        LAG(avg_purchase_price) OVER (PARTITION BY region ORDER BY txn_year) as prev_year_price,
        CASE 
            WHEN LAG(avg_purchase_price) OVER (PARTITION BY region ORDER BY txn_year) IS NULL THEN NULL
            ELSE ((avg_purchase_price - LAG(avg_purchase_price) OVER (PARTITION BY region ORDER BY txn_year)) * 100.0 / LAG(avg_purchase_price) OVER (PARTITION BY region ORDER BY txn_year))
        END as pct_change
    FROM ranked
)
SELECT 
    region,
    txn_year,
    ROUND(avg_purchase_price, 2) as avg_purchase_price,
    price_rank,
    ROUND(pct_change, 2) as pct_change
FROM with_pct_change

WITH stats AS (
  SELECT 
    AVG("loss_rate_%") as avg_loss_rate,
    STDDEV_POP("loss_rate_%") as std_loss_rate
  FROM veg_loss_rate_df
  WHERE "loss_rate_%" IS NOT NULL
),
categorized AS (
  SELECT 
    v."loss_rate_%",
    s.avg_loss_rate,
    s.std_loss_rate,
    CASE 
      WHEN v."loss_rate_%" < s.avg_loss_rate - s.std_loss_rate THEN 'below'
      WHEN v."loss_rate_%" > s.avg_loss_rate + s.std_loss_rate THEN 'above'
      ELSE 'within'
    END as category
  FROM veg_loss_rate_df v
  CROSS JOIN stats s
  WHERE v."loss_rate_%" IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT 
  ANY_VALUE(avg_loss_rate) as avg_loss_rate,
  ANY_VALUE(std_loss_rate) as std_loss_rate,
  COUNT(*) as total_items,
  SUM(CASE WHEN category = 'below' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as count_below,
  SUM(CASE WHEN category = 'above' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as count_above,
  SUM(CASE WHEN category = 'within' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as count_within
FROM categorized

    SELECT 
        "loss_rate_%",
        l.avg_loss_rate,
        l.std_dev,
        CASE 
            WHEN "loss_rate_%" < l.avg_loss_rate - l.std_dev THEN 'below'
            WHEN "loss_rate_%" > l.avg_loss_rate + l.std_dev THEN 'above'
            ELSE 'within'

    FROM veg_loss_rate_df
    CROSS JOIN loss_stats l
)

    avg_loss_rate,
    std_dev,
    COUNT(*) as total_items,
    SUM(CASE WHEN classification = 'below' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as below_std,
    SUM(CASE WHEN classification = 'above' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as above_std,
    SUM(CASE WHEN classification = 'within' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as within_std
FROM item_classification
GROUP BY avg_loss_rate, std_dev

candidates.sql:
WITH 
-- Wholesale data per item per year
wholesale_yearly AS (
    SELECT 
        CAST(strftime('%Y', CAST(whsle_date AS DATE)) AS INTEGER) as year,
        item_code,
        AVG("whsle_px_rmb-kg") as avg_wholesale_price,
        MAX("whsle_px_rmb-kg") as max_wholesale_price,
        MIN("whsle_px_rmb-kg") as min_wholesale_price
    FROM veg_whsle_df
    WHERE CAST(strftime('%Y', CAST(whsle_date AS DATE)) AS INTEGER) IN (2020, 2021, 2022, 2023)
    GROUP BY year, item_code
),

-- Selling data per item per year (only sales, not returns)
selling_yearly AS (
    SELECT 
        CAST(strftime('%Y', CAST(txn_date AS DATE)) AS INTEGER) as year,
        item_code,
        SUM("qty_sold(kg)" * "unit_selling_px_rmb/kg") as total_selling_value
    FROM veg_txn_df
    WHERE "sale/return" = 'sale'
    AND CAST(strftime('%Y', CAST(txn_date AS DATE)) AS INTEGER) IN (2020, 2021, 2022, 2023)
    GROUP BY year, item_code
),

-- Loss rates per item
item_loss_rates AS (
    SELECT 
        item_code,
        AVG("loss_rate_%") as avg_loss_rate
    FROM veg_loss_rate_df
    GROUP BY item_code
),

-- Combine all data
combined AS (
    SELECT 
        w.year,
        w.item_code,
        c.category_name,
        w.avg_wholesale_price,
        w.max_wholesale_price,
        w.min_wholesale_price,
        w.max_wholesale_price - w.min_wholesale_price as wholesale_price_difference,
        COALESCE(s.total_selling_value, 0) as total_selling_value,
        r.avg_loss_rate
    FROM wholesale_yearly w
    JOIN veg_cat c ON w.item_code = c.item_code
    LEFT JOIN selling_yearly s ON w.year = s.year AND w.item_code = s.item_code
    LEFT JOIN item_loss_rates r ON w.item_code = r.item_code
)

SELECT 
    category_name,
    year,
    ROUND(AVG(avg_wholesale_price), 2) as average_wholesale_price,
    ROUND(AVG(max_wholesale_price), 2) as maximum_wholesale_price,
    ROUND(AVG(min_wholesale_price), 2) as minimum_wholesale_price,
    ROUND(AVG(wholesale_price_difference), 2) as wholesale_price_difference,
    ROUND(SUM(total_selling_value), 2) as total_wholesale_price,
    ROUND(SUM(total_selling_value), 2) as total_selling_price,
    ROUND(AVG(avg_loss_rate), 2) as average_loss_rate,
    ROUND(SUM(total_selling_value) * AVG(avg_loss_rate) / 100, 2) as total_loss,
    ROUND(SUM(total_selling_value) * (1 - AVG(avg_loss_rate) / 100), 2) as profit
FROM combined
GROUP BY category_name, year
ORDER BY year, category_name

),

    SELECT 
        CAST(strftime('%Y', txn_date) AS INTEGER) as year,
        item_code,
        SUM(qty_sold(kg) * unit_selling_px_rmb/kg) as total_selling_price
    FROM veg_txn_df

    AND CAST(strftime('%Y', txn_date) AS INTEGER) IN (2020, 2021, 2022, 2023)

),

combined AS (

        c.category_name,

WITH monthly_nets AS (
    SELECT 
        customer_id,
        date_trunc('month', CAST(txn_date AS DATE)) AS month_start,
        CASE WHEN txn_type = 'deposit' THEN txn_amount ELSE -txn_amount END AS net_amount
    FROM customer_transactions
    WHERE txn_type IN ('deposit', 'withdrawal')
),
monthly_sum AS (
    SELECT 
        customer_id,
        month_start,
        SUM(net_amount) AS monthly_net
    FROM monthly_nets
    GROUP BY customer_id, month_start
),
cumulative_balance AS (
    SELECT 
        customer_id,
        month_start,
        monthly_net,
        SUM(monthly_net) OVER (PARTITION BY customer_id ORDER BY month_start) AS closing_balance
    FROM monthly_sum
),
latest_month AS (
    SELECT 
        customer_id,
        month_start,
        closing_balance
    FROM (
        SELECT 
            customer_id,
            month_start,
            closing_balance,
            ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY customer_id ORDER BY month_start DESC) AS rn
        FROM cumulative_balance
    )
    WHERE rn = 1
),
prior_month AS (
    SELECT 
        l.customer_id,
        l.month_start,
        l.closing_balance,
        p.closing_balance AS prior_balance
    FROM latest_month l
    LEFT JOIN cumulative_balance p 
        ON l.customer_id = p.customer_id 
        AND p.month_start = (
            SELECT MAX(month_start) 
            FROM cumulative_balance cb3 
            WHERE cb3.customer_id = l.customer_id 
            AND cb3.month_start < l.month_start
        )
),
with_growth_rate AS (
    SELECT 
        customer_id,
        month_start,
        closing_balance,
        prior_balance,
        CASE 
            WHEN prior_balance = 0 THEN closing_balance * 100
            ELSE (closing_balance - prior_balance) * 100.0 / prior_balance
        END AS growth_rate
    FROM prior_month
)
SELECT 
    ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN growth_rate > 5 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(CASE WHEN growth_rate IS NOT NULL THEN 1 END), 2) AS percentage_of_customers
FROM with_growth_rate
WHERE growth_rate IS NOT NULL

WITH user_monthly_transactions AS (
  SELECT 
    customer_id,
    date_trunc('month', txn_date::DATE) as month_start,
    SUM(CASE WHEN txn_type = 'deposit' THEN txn_amount ELSE 0 END) as deposits,
    SUM(CASE WHEN txn_type = 'withdrawal' THEN txn_amount ELSE 0 END) as withdrawals
  FROM customer_transactions
  GROUP BY customer_id, date_trunc('month', txn_date::DATE)
),
user_cumulative_balances AS (
  SELECT 
    customer_id,
    month_start,
    deposits,
    withdrawals,
    SUM(deposits - withdrawals) OVER (
      PARTITION BY customer_id 
      ORDER BY month_start 
      ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW
    ) as cumulative_balance
  FROM user_monthly_transactions
),
monthly_total_balances AS (
  SELECT 
    month_start,
    SUM(cumulative_balance) as total_balance
  FROM user_cumulative_balances
  GROUP BY month_start
)
SELECT 
  month_start,
  GREATEST(0, total_balance) as total_balance
FROM monthly_total_balances
WHERE month_start != (SELECT MIN(month_start) FROM monthly_total_balances)
ORDER BY month_start

WITH daily_balance AS (
    SELECT 
        customer_id,
        txn_date,
        txn_type,
        txn_amount,
        SUM(CASE WHEN txn_type = 'deposit' THEN txn_amount ELSE -txn_amount END) OVER (
            PARTITION BY customer_id 
            ORDER BY CAST(txn_date AS DATE)
            ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW
        ) AS running_balance
    FROM customer_transactions
),
daily_summary AS (
    SELECT 
        customer_id,
        txn_date,
        CAST(txn_date AS DATE) AS txn_date_dt,
        running_balance
    FROM daily_balance
),
rolling_avg AS (
    SELECT 
        customer_id,
        txn_date_dt,
        running_balance,
        AVG(running_balance) OVER (
            PARTITION BY customer_id 
            ORDER BY txn_date_dt
            ROWS BETWEEN 29 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW
        ) AS thirty_day_avg
    FROM daily_summary
),
with_negative_zero AS (
    SELECT 
        customer_id,
        txn_date_dt,
        thirty_day_avg,
        CASE WHEN thirty_day_avg < 0 THEN 0.0 ELSE thirty_day_avg END AS thirty_day_avg_zero
    FROM rolling_avg
),
customer_first_month AS (
    SELECT 
        customer_id,
        MIN(txn_date_dt) AS first_txn_date,
        substr(CAST(first_txn_date AS VARCHAR), 1, 7) AS first_month
    FROM daily_summary
    GROUP BY customer_id
),
qualifying_rows AS (
    SELECT 
        w.customer_id,
        w.txn_date_dt,
        w.thirty_day_avg_zero,
        f.first_month
    FROM with_negative_zero w
    JOIN customer_first_month f ON w.customer_id = f.customer_id
    WHERE w.txn_date_dt >= f.first_txn_date + INTERVAL '29 days'
),
monthly_max AS (
    SELECT 
        customer_id,
        substr(CAST(txn_date_dt AS VARCHAR), 1, 7) AS month,
        MAX(thirty_day_avg_zero) AS max_monthly_avg
    FROM qualifying_rows
    WHERE substr(CAST(txn_date_dt AS VARCHAR), 1, 7) != first_month
    GROUP BY customer_id, substr(CAST(txn_date_dt AS VARCHAR), 1, 7)
)
SELECT month, SUM(max_monthly_avg) AS total
FROM monthly_max
GROUP BY month
ORDER BY month

WITH week_selection AS (
  SELECT 
    2018 AS year,
    '2018-06-18' as ref_week,
    '2018-05-21' as before1, '2018-05-28' as before2, '2018-06-04' as before3, '2018-06-11' as before4,
    '2018-06-18' as after1, '2018-06-25' as after2, '2018-07-02' as after3, '2018-07-09' as after4
  UNION ALL
  SELECT 
    2019, '2019-06-17',
    '2019-05-20', '2019-05-27', '2019-06-03', '2019-06-10',
    '2019-06-17', '2019-06-24', '2019-07-01', '2019-07-08'
  UNION ALL
  SELECT 
    2020, '2020-06-15',
    '2020-05-18', '2020-05-25', '2020-06-01', '2020-06-08',
    '2020-06-15', '2020-06-22', '2020-06-29', '2020-07-06'
)
SELECT 
  year,
  ref_week,
  SUM(CASE WHEN week_date = before1 THEN sales ELSE 0 END) as before1_sales,
  SUM(CASE WHEN week_date = before2 THEN sales ELSE 0 END) as before2_sales,
  SUM(CASE WHEN week_date = before3 THEN sales ELSE 0 END) as before3_sales,
  SUM(CASE WHEN week_date = before4 THEN sales ELSE 0 END) as before4_sales,
  SUM(CASE WHEN week_date = after1 THEN sales ELSE 0 END) as after1_sales,

  SUM(CASE WHEN week_date = after3 THEN sales ELSE 0 END) as after3_sales,
  SUM(CASE WHEN week_date = after4 THEN sales ELSE 0 END) as after4_sales
FROM cleaned_weekly_sales
CROSS JOIN week_selection
WHERE cleaned_weekly_sales.calendar_year = week_selection.year
GROUP BY year, ref_week, before1, before2, before3, before4, after1, after2, after3, after4
ORDER BY year

candidates.sql:
WITH week_info AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT week_number, week_date_formatted
    FROM cleaned_weekly_sales
    WHERE calendar_year = 2020
),
before_period AS (
    SELECT 
        region, platform, age_band, demographic, customer_type,
        AVG(sales) as avg_sales_before
    FROM cleaned_weekly_sales
    WHERE calendar_year = 2020 AND week_number BETWEEN 13 AND 24
    GROUP BY region, platform, age_band, demographic, customer_type
),
after_period AS (
    SELECT 
        region, platform, age_band, demographic, customer_type,
        AVG(sales) as avg_sales_after
    FROM cleaned_weekly_sales
    WHERE calendar_year = 2020 AND week_number BETWEEN 26 AND 36
    GROUP BY region, platform, age_band, demographic, customer_type
),
combined AS (
    SELECT 
        b.region, b.platform, b.age_band, b.demographic, b.customer_type,
        b.avg_sales_before, a.avg_sales_after,
        ROUND((a.avg_sales_after - b.avg_sales_before) * 100.0 / b.avg_sales_before, 2) as pct_change
    FROM before_period b
    JOIN after_period a ON 
        b.region = a.region AND 
        b.platform = a.platform AND 
        b.age_band = a.age_band AND 
        b.demographic = a.demographic AND 
        b.customer_type = a.customer_type
),
region_stats AS (
    SELECT region, AVG(pct_change) as avg_pct_change
    FROM combined
    GROUP BY region
),
platform_stats AS (
    SELECT platform, AVG(pct_change) as avg_pct_change
    FROM combined
    GROUP BY platform
),
age_band_stats AS (
    SELECT age_band, AVG(pct_change) as avg_pct_change
    FROM combined
    GROUP BY age_band
),
demographic_stats AS (
    SELECT demographic, AVG(pct_change) as avg_pct_change
    FROM combined
    GROUP BY demographic
),
customer_type_stats AS (
    SELECT customer_type, AVG(pct_change) as avg_pct_change
    FROM combined
    GROUP BY customer_type
)

    'region' as attr_type, ROUND(AVG(avg_pct_change), 2) as overall_avg_pct_change

UNION ALL

FROM platform_stats
UNION ALL
SELECT 
    'age_band' as attr_type, ROUND(AVG(avg_pct_change), 2) as overall_avg_pct_change
FROM age_band_stats
UNION ALL
SELECT 
    'demographic' as attr_type, ROUND(AVG(avg_pct_change), 2) as overall_avg_pct_change
FROM demographic_stats
UNION ALL
SELECT 
    'customer_type' as attr_type, ROUND(AVG(avg_pct_change), 2) as overall_avg_pct_change

<parameter=sql>
WITH week_info AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT week_number, week_date_formatted
    FROM cleaned_weekly_sales
    WHERE calendar_year = 2020
),
before_period AS (
    SELECT 
        region, platform, age_band, demographic, customer_type,
        AVG(sales) as avg_sales_before
    FROM cleaned_weekly_sales
    WHERE calendar_year = 2020 AND week_number BETWEEN 13 AND 24
    GROUP BY region, platform, age_band, demographic, customer_type
),
after_period AS (
    SELECT 
        region, platform, age_band, demographic, customer_type,
        AVG(sales) as avg_sales_after
    FROM cleaned_weekly_sales
    WHERE calendar_year = 2020 AND week_number BETWEEN 26 AND 36
    GROUP BY region, platform, age_band, demographic, customer_type
),
combined AS (
    SELECT 
        b.region, b.platform, b.age_band, b.demographic, b.customer_type,
        b.avg_sales_before, a.avg_sales_after,
        (a.avg_sales_after - b.avg_sales_before) * 100.0 / b.avg_sales_before as pct_change
    FROM before_period b
    JOIN after_period a ON 
        b.region = a.region AND 
        b.platform = a.platform AND 
        b.age_band = a.age_band AND 
        b.demographic = a.demographic AND 
        b.customer_type = a.customer_type
),
region_avg AS (
    SELECT region, AVG(pct_change) as avg_pct_change
    FROM combined
    GROUP BY region
),
platform_avg AS (
    SELECT platform, AVG(pct_change) as avg_pct_change
    FROM combined
    GROUP BY platform
),
age_band_avg AS (
    SELECT age_band, AVG(pct_change) as avg_pct_change
    FROM combined
    GROUP BY age_band
),
demographic_avg AS (
    SELECT demographic, AVG(pct_change) as avg_pct_change
    FROM combined
    GROUP BY demographic
),
customer_type_avg AS (
    SELECT customer_type, AVG(pct_change) as avg_pct_change
    FROM combined
    GROUP BY customer_type
)
SELECT 
    'region' as attribute_type, region as attribute_value, avg_pct_change as avg_pct_change, 
    1 as rank_order
    UNION ALL
    SELECT 'platform' as attribute_type, platform as attribute_value, avg_pct_change, 2
    FROM platform_avg
    UNION ALL
    SELECT 'age_band' as attribute_type, age_band as attribute_value, avg_pct_change, 3

WITH before_period AS (

    GROUP BY region, platform, age_band, demographic, customer_type
),
after_period AS (

        AVG(sales) as avg_sales_after
    FROM cleaned_weekly_sales
    WHERE calendar_year = 2020 AND week_number BETWEEN 26 AND 36
    GROUP BY region, platform, age_band, demographic, customer_type
),
combined AS (
    SELECT 
        b.region, b.platform, b.age_band, b.demographic, b.customer_type,
        b.avg_sales_before, a.avg_sales_after,
        (a.avg_sales_after - b.avg_sales_before) * 100.0 / b.avg_sales_before as pct_change
    FROM before_period b
    JOIN after_period a ON 
        b.region = a.region AND 
        b.platform = a.platform AND 
        b.age_band = a.age_band AND 
        b.demographic = a.demographic AND 
        b.customer_type = a.customer_type
)
SELECT MIN(pct_change) as min_pct_change, MAX(pct_change) as max_pct_change, COUNT(*) as total_rows
FROM combined

WITH before_sales AS (
    SELECT 
        region, platform, age_band, demographic, customer_type,
        AVG(sales) as avg_sales_before
    FROM cleaned_weekly_sales
    WHERE week_number BETWEEN 13 AND 24
    GROUP BY region, platform, age_band, demographic, customer_type
),
after_sales AS (
    SELECT 
        region, platform, age_band, demographic, customer_type,
        AVG(sales) as avg_sales_after
    FROM cleaned_weekly_sales
    WHERE week_number BETWEEN 26 AND 36
    GROUP BY region, platform, age_band, demographic, customer_type
),
combined AS (
    SELECT 
        b.region, b.platform, b.age_band, b.demographic, b.customer_type,
        b.avg_sales_before, a.avg_sales_after,
        CASE WHEN b.avg_sales_before > 0 
             THEN ((a.avg_sales_after - b.avg_sales_before) * 100.0 / b.avg_sales_before)
             ELSE 0 END as pct_change
    FROM before_sales b
    JOIN after_sales a 
        ON b.region = a.region 
        AND b.platform = a.platform 
        AND b.age_band = a.age_band 
        AND b.demographic = a.demographic 
        AND b.customer_type = a.customer_type
)
SELECT platform, AVG(pct_change) as avg_pct_change, COUNT(*) as num_values
FROM combined
GROUP BY platform
ORDER BY avg_pct_change

<tool_call>
<function=run_sql_query>
<parameter=sql>
WITH all_weeks AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT week_number FROM cleaned_weekly_sales WHERE calendar_year = 2020
),
pre_weeks AS (
    SELECT week_number FROM all_weeks WHERE week_number BETWEEN 13 AND 24
),
post_weeks AS (
    SELECT week_number FROM all_weeks WHERE week_number BETWEEN 26 AND 37
),
pre_sales AS (
    SELECT 
        region, platform, age_band, demographic, customer_type,
        AVG(sales) as pre_avg_sales
    FROM cleaned_weekly_sales cws
    WHERE calendar_year = 2020 AND week_number IN (SELECT week_number FROM pre_weeks)
    GROUP BY region, platform, age_band, demographic, customer_type
),
post_sales AS (
    SELECT 
        region, platform, age_band, demographic, customer_type,
        AVG(sales) as post_avg_sales
    FROM cleaned_weekly_sales cws
    WHERE calendar_year = 2020 AND week_number IN (SELECT week_number FROM post_weeks)
    GROUP BY region, platform, age_band, demographic, customer_type
),
sales_change AS (
    SELECT 
        p.region, p.platform, p.age_band, p.demographic, p.customer_type,
        p.pre_avg_sales, ps.post_avg_sales,
        (ps.post_avg_sales * 100.0 / p.pre_avg_sales - 100) as pct_change
    FROM pre_sales p
    JOIN post_sales ps ON p.region = ps.region 
        AND p.platform = ps.platform 
        AND p.age_band = ps.age_band 
        AND p.demographic = ps.demographic 
        AND p.customer_type = ps.customer_type
),
region_analysis AS (
    SELECT 'region' as attr_type, region as attr_value, AVG(pct_change) as avg_pct_change 
    FROM sales_change GROUP BY region
),
platform_analysis AS (
    SELECT 'platform' as attr_type, platform as attr_value, AVG(pct_change) as avg_pct_change 
    FROM sales_change GROUP BY platform
),
age_band_analysis AS (
    SELECT 'age_band' as attr_type, age_band as attr_value, AVG(pct_change) as avg_pct_change 
    FROM sales_change GROUP BY age_band
),
demographic_analysis AS (
    SELECT 'demographic' as attr_type, demographic as attr_value, AVG(pct_change) as avg_pct_change 
    FROM sales_change GROUP BY demographic
),
customer_type_analysis AS (
    SELECT 'customer_type' as attr_type, customer_type as attr_value, AVG(pct_change) as avg_pct_change 
    FROM sales_change GROUP BY customer_type
)
SELECT attr_type, attr_value, avg_pct_change
FROM region_analysis
UNION ALL
SELECT attr_type, attr_value, avg_pct_change FROM platform_analysis
UNION ALL
SELECT attr_type, attr_value, avg_pct_change FROM age_band_analysis
UNION ALL
SELECT attr_type, attr_value, avg_pct_change FROM demographic_analysis
UNION ALL
SELECT attr_type, attr_value, avg_pct_change FROM customer_type_analysis
ORDER BY avg_pct_change
</parameter>

</function>

WITH before_avg AS (
  SELECT 
    region, platform, age_band, demographic, customer_type,
    AVG(sales) as avg_sales_before
  FROM cleaned_weekly_sales
  WHERE calendar_year = 2020 AND week_number BETWEEN 13 AND 24
  GROUP BY region, platform, age_band, demographic, customer_type
),
after_avg AS (
  SELECT 
    region, platform, age_band, demographic, customer_type,
    AVG(sales) as avg_sales_after
  FROM cleaned_weekly_sales
  WHERE calendar_year = 2020 AND week_number BETWEEN 26 AND 36
  GROUP BY region, platform, age_band, demographic, customer_type
),
percentage_change AS (
  SELECT 
    b.region, b.platform, b.age_band, b.demographic, b.customer_type,
    ((a.avg_sales_after - b.avg_sales_before) * 100.0 / b.avg_sales_before) as pct_change
  FROM before_avg b
  JOIN after_avg a USING (region, platform, age_band, demographic, customer_type)
),
region_avg AS (
  SELECT region, AVG(pct_change) as avg_pct, COUNT(*) as cnt
  FROM percentage_change
  GROUP BY region
),
platform_avg AS (
  SELECT platform, AVG(pct_change) as avg_pct, COUNT(*) as cnt
  FROM percentage_change
  GROUP BY platform
),
age_band_avg AS (
  SELECT age_band, AVG(pct_change) as avg_pct, COUNT(*) as cnt
  FROM percentage_change
  GROUP BY age_band
),
demographic_avg AS (
  SELECT demographic, AVG(pct_change) as avg_pct, COUNT(*) as cnt
  FROM percentage_change
  GROUP BY demographic
),
customer_type_avg AS (
  SELECT customer_type, AVG(pct_change) as avg_pct, COUNT(*) as cnt
  FROM percentage_change
  GROUP BY customer_type
)
SELECT 
  'region' as attr_type,
  AVG(avg_pct) as overall_avg,
  AVG(COUNT(*)) as avg_count_per_attr
FROM region_avg
UNION ALL
SELECT 
  'platform' as attr_type,
  AVG(avg_pct) as overall_avg,
  AVG(COUNT(*)) as avg_count_per_attr
FROM platform_avg
UNION ALL
SELECT 
  'age_band' as attr_type,

  AVG(COUNT(*)) as avg_count_per_attr
FROM age_band_avg
UNION ALL
SELECT 
  'demographic' as attr_type,
  AVG(avg_pct) as overall_avg,
  AVG(COUNT(*)) as avg_count_per_attr
FROM demographic_avg
UNION ALL
SELECT 
  'customer_type' as attr_type,
  AVG(avg_pct) as overall_avg,
  AVG(COUNT(*)) as avg_count_per_attr
FROM customer_type_avg

local068.question: Calculate the number of new cities inserted in April, May, and June for each year from 2021 to 2023. For each month, compute the cumulative running total of cities added for that specific month across the years up to and including the given year (i.e., sum the counts of that month over the years). Additionally, calculate the year-over-year growth percentages for both the monthly total and the running total for each month, comparing each year to the previous year. Present the results only for 2022 and 2023, listing the year, the month, the total number of cities added in that month, the cumulative running total for that month, and the year-over-year growth percentages for both the monthly total and the running total. Use the data from 2021 solely as a baseline for calculating growth rates, and exclude it from the final output.

candidates.sql:
WITH monthly_counts AS (
    SELECT 
        TRY_CAST(SUBSTRING(insert_date, 1, 4) AS INTEGER) AS year,
        TRY_CAST(SUBSTRING(insert_date, 6, 2) AS INTEGER) AS month,
        COUNT(*) AS city_count
    FROM cities
    WHERE insert_date LIKE '2021-%' OR insert_date LIKE '2022-%' OR insert_date LIKE '2023-%'
      AND (substring(insert_date, 6, 2) = '04' OR substring(insert_date, 6, 2) = '05' OR substring(insert_date, 6, 2) = '06')
    GROUP BY year, month
),
monthly_with_totals AS (
    SELECT 
        year,
        month,
        city_count,
        SUM(city_count) OVER (PARTITION BY month ORDER BY year ROWS UNBOUNDED PRECEDING) AS running_total
    FROM monthly_counts
    WHERE month IN (4, 5, 6)
    ORDER BY month, year
),
with_growth AS (
    SELECT 
        m.year,
        m.month,
        m.city_count AS monthly_total,
        m.running_total,
        LAG(m.city_count) OVER (PARTITION BY m.month ORDER BY m.year) AS prev_monthly,
        LAG(m.running_total) OVER (PARTITION BY m.month ORDER BY m.year) AS prev_running,
        CASE 
            WHEN LAG(m.city_count) OVER (PARTITION BY m.month ORDER BY m.year) IS NULL THEN 0
            ELSE ROUND((m.city_count - LAG(m.city_count) OVER (PARTITION BY m.month ORDER BY m.year)) * 100.0 / LAG(m.city_count) OVER (PARTITION BY m.month ORDER BY m.year), 2)
        END AS monthly_growth_pct,
        CASE 
            WHEN LAG(m.running_total) OVER (PARTITION BY m.month ORDER BY m.year) IS NULL THEN 0
            ELSE ROUND((m.running_total - LAG(m.running_total) OVER (PARTITION BY m.month ORDER BY m.year)) * 100.0 / LAG(m.running_total) OVER (PARTITION BY m.month ORDER BY m.year), 2)
        END AS running_growth_pct
    FROM monthly_with_totals m
    WHERE m.year IN (2021, 2022, 2023)
    ORDER BY m.month, m.year
)
SELECT 
    year,
    month,
    monthly_total,
    running_total,
    monthly_growth_pct,
    running_growth_pct
FROM with_growth
WHERE year IN (2022, 2023)
ORDER BY month, year

WITH monthly_counts AS (
    SELECT 
        CAST(SUBSTR(insert_date, 1, 4) AS INTEGER) AS year,
        SUBSTR(insert_date, 6, 2) AS month,
        COUNT(*) AS city_count
    FROM cities
    WHERE insert_date LIKE '2021-04-%' OR insert_date LIKE '2021-05-%' 
       OR insert_date LIKE '2021-06-%'
       OR insert_date LIKE '2022-04-%' OR insert_date LIKE '2022-05-%' 
       OR insert_date LIKE '2022-06-%'
       OR insert_date LIKE '2023-04-%' OR insert_date LIKE '2023-05-%' 
       OR insert_date LIKE '2023-06-%'
    GROUP BY year, month
),
with_running_totals AS (
    SELECT 
        year,
        month,
        city_count AS monthly_total,
        SUM(city_count) OVER (PARTITION BY month ORDER BY year) AS running_total
    FROM monthly_counts
),
with_previous_running AS (
    SELECT 
        year,
        month,
        monthly_total,
        running_total,
        LAG(running_total) OVER (PARTITION BY month ORDER BY year) AS prev_running_total,
        LAG(monthly_total) OVER (PARTITION BY month ORDER BY year) AS prev_monthly_total
    FROM with_running_totals
)
SELECT 
    year,
    month,
    monthly_total,
    running_total,
    ROUND((CAST(monthly_total AS FLOAT) / NULLIF(prev_monthly_total, 0) - 1) * 100, 2) AS monthly_yoy_growth_pct,
    ROUND((CAST(running_total AS FLOAT) / NULLIF(prev_running_total, 0) - 1) * 100, 2) AS running_yoy_growth_pct
FROM with_previous_running
WHERE year IN (2022, 2023)
ORDER BY year, month

WITH base_data AS (
    SELECT 
        CAST(SUBSTR(insert_date, 1, 4) AS INTEGER) AS year,
        CAST(SUBSTR(insert_date, 6, 2) AS INTEGER) AS month,
        COUNT(*) AS city_count
    FROM cities
    WHERE CAST(SUBSTR(insert_date, 6, 2) AS INTEGER) IN (4, 5, 6)
        AND (CAST(SUBSTR(insert_date, 1, 4) AS INTEGER) IN (2021, 2022, 2023))
    GROUP BY year, month
),
with_running AS (
    SELECT 
        year,
        month,
        city_count AS monthly_total,
        SUM(city_count) OVER (PARTITION BY month ORDER BY year) AS cumulative_running_total
    FROM base_data
),
with_prev AS (
    SELECT 
        year,
        month,
        monthly_total,
        cumulative_running_total,
        LAG(monthly_total) OVER (PARTITION BY month ORDER BY year) AS prev_monthly,
        LAG(cumulative_running_total) OVER (PARTITION BY month ORDER BY year) AS prev_running_total
    FROM with_running
)
SELECT 
    year,
    month,
    monthly_total,
    cumulative_running_total,
    CASE 
        WHEN prev_monthly IS NOT NULL AND prev_monthly > 0
        THEN ROUND((1.0 * (monthly_total - prev_monthly) / prev_monthly) * 100, 2)
        ELSE NULL
    END AS monthly_yoy_growth_pct,
    CASE 
        WHEN prev_running_total IS NOT NULL AND prev_running_total > 0
        THEN ROUND((1.0 * (cumulative_running_total - prev_running_total) / prev_running_total) * 100, 2)
        ELSE NULL
    END AS running_total_yoy_growth_pct
FROM with_prev
WHERE year IN (2022, 2023)
ORDER BY year, month

WITH female_legislators_with_terms AS (
  SELECT 
    l.id_bioguide,
    l.gender,
    lt.state,
    lt.term_start,
    lt.term_end,
    CAST(SUBSTR(lt.term_start, 1, 4) AS INTEGER) as start_year,
    CAST(SUBSTR(lt.term_end, 1, 4) AS INTEGER) as end_year,
    CAST(SUBSTR(lt.term_start, 6, 2) AS INTEGER) as start_month,
    CAST(SUBSTR(lt.term_end, 6, 2) AS INTEGER) as end_month
  FROM legislators l
  JOIN legislators_terms lt ON l.id_bioguide = lt.id_bioguide
  WHERE l.gender = 'F'
),
terms_with_dec31 AS (
  SELECT *
  FROM female_legislators_with_terms
  WHERE 
    end_year > start_year
    OR (end_year = start_year AND end_month >= 12)
),
first_state_per_legislator AS (
  SELECT 
    id_bioguide,
    state as first_state
  FROM (
    SELECT 
      id_bioguide,
      state,
      ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY id_bioguide ORDER BY term_start) as rn
    FROM terms_with_dec31
  )
  WHERE rn = 1
),
count_per_state AS (
  SELECT 
    first_state,
    COUNT(*) as count
  FROM first_state_per_legislator
  GROUP BY first_state
  ORDER BY count DESC
)
SELECT * FROM count_per_state

WITH filtered_jobs AS (
    SELECT job_id, salary_year_avg
    FROM job_postings_fact
    WHERE job_title_short = 'Data Analyst'
        AND salary_year_avg IS NOT NULL
        AND job_work_from_home = 1
),
skill_freq AS (
    SELECT sjd.skill_id, COUNT(*) as skill_count
    FROM filtered_jobs fj
    JOIN skills_job_dim sjd ON fj.job_id = sjd.job_id
    WHERE sjd.skill_id IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY sjd.skill_id
),
top_skills AS (
    SELECT skill_id
    FROM skill_freq
    ORDER BY skill_count DESC
    LIMIT 3
)
SELECT DISTINCT fj.job_id, fj.salary_year_avg
FROM filtered_jobs fj
WHERE fj.job_id IN (
    SELECT sjd.job_id
    FROM skills_job_dim sjd
    WHERE sjd.skill_id IN (SELECT skill_id FROM top_skills)
)

WITH matching_jobs AS (
    SELECT j.job_id, j.salary_year_avg
    FROM job_postings_fact j
    WHERE j.job_title_short = 'Data Analyst'
      AND j.salary_year_avg IS NOT NULL
      AND j.job_work_from_home = 1
),
job_skills AS (
    SELECT mj.job_id, sj.skill_id, s.skills
    FROM matching_jobs mj
    JOIN skills_job_dim sj ON mj.job_id = sj.job_id
    JOIN skills_dim s ON sj.skill_id = s.skill_id
),
skill_counts AS (
    SELECT skills, COUNT(*) as skill_count
    FROM job_skills
    GROUP BY skills
),
top_skills AS (
    SELECT skills
    FROM skill_counts
    ORDER BY skill_count DESC, skills ASC
    LIMIT 3
),
filtered_salaries AS (
    SELECT ms.salary_year_avg
    FROM matching_jobs ms
    JOIN job_skills js ON ms.job_id = js.job_id
    WHERE js.skills IN (SELECT skills FROM top_skills)
)
SELECT AVG(salary_year_avg) as average_salary
FROM filtered_salaries

    UNION ALL SELECT 11 UNION ALL SELECT 12 UNION ALL SELECT 13 UNION ALL SELECT 14 UNION ALL SELECT 15

),
cohort AS (
    SELECT id_bioguide, term_start, CAST(term_start AS DATE) AS term_start_date
    FROM legislators_terms
    WHERE term_number = 0 
      AND term_start >= '1917-01-01' 
      AND term_start <= '1999-12-31'
),
year_ends AS (
    SELECT 
        c.id_bioguide,
        c.term_start,
        c.term_start_date,
        n,
        EXTRACT(YEAR FROM c.term_start_date)::INTEGER + n - 1 AS check_year
    FROM cohort c
    CROSS JOIN years_sequence n
),
still_in_office AS (
    SELECT 
        y.id_bioguide,
        y.check_year,
        CASE WHEN EXISTS (
            SELECT 1 
            FROM legislators_terms lt 
            WHERE lt.id_bioguide = y.id_bioguide 
              AND CAST(lt.term_start AS DATE) <= DATE(y.check_year || '-12-31') 
              AND (lt.term_end IS NULL OR CAST(lt.term_end AS DATE) > DATE(y.check_year || '-12-31'))
        ) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS still_in_office
    FROM year_ends y
)
SELECT 
    check_year - MIN(check_year) OVER () AS year_offset,
    ROUND(1.0 * SUM(still_in_office) / COUNT(*), 4) AS retention_rate
FROM still_in_office
GROUP BY check_year
ORDER BY check_year

local170.question: Identify the state abbreviations where, for both male and female legislators, the retention rate remains greater than zero at specific intervals of 0, 2, 4, 6, 8, and 10 years after their first term start date. A legislator is considered retained if they are serving on December 31 of the respective year. Only include states where both gender cohorts maintain non-zero retention rates at all six of these time points during the first decade of service.

candidates.sql:
WITH first_terms AS (
    SELECT 
        l.id_bioguide,
        l.gender,
        lt.state,
        CAST(strftime('%Y', CAST(lt.term_start AS DATE)) AS INTEGER) AS start_year
    FROM legislators l
    JOIN legislators_terms lt ON l.id_bioguide = lt.id_bioguide
    WHERE lt.term_number = 0
),
years_to_check AS (
    SELECT id_bioguide, gender, state, start_year + 0 AS check_year FROM first_terms
    UNION ALL
    SELECT id_bioguide, gender, state, start_year + 2 AS check_year FROM first_terms
    UNION ALL
    SELECT id_bioguide, gender, state, start_year + 4 AS check_year FROM first_terms
    UNION ALL
    SELECT id_bioguide, gender, state, start_year + 6 AS check_year FROM first_terms
    UNION ALL
    SELECT id_bioguide, gender, state, start_year + 8 AS check_year FROM first_terms
    UNION ALL
    SELECT id_bioguide, gender, state, start_year + 10 AS check_year FROM first_terms
),
retained AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT
        ytc.id_bioguide,
        ytc.gender,
        ytc.state,
        ytc.check_year,
        CASE WHEN EXISTS (
            SELECT 1 FROM legislators_terms lt
            WHERE lt.id_bioguide = ytc.id_bioguide
            AND CAST(lt.term_start AS DATE) <= date(ytc.check_year || '-12-31')
            AND CAST(lt.term_end AS DATE) >= date(ytc.check_year || '-12-31')
        ) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS is_retained
    FROM years_to_check ytc
),
retention_by_state_gender AS (
    SELECT 
        state,
        gender,
        check_year,
        COUNT(DISTINCT id_bioguide) AS count_retained
    FROM retained
    WHERE is_retained = 1
    GROUP BY state, gender, check_year
    HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT id_bioguide) > 0
),
state_gender_years AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT state, gender
    FROM retention_by_state_gender
),
males AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT state
    FROM retention_by_state_gender
    WHERE gender = 'M'
),
females AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT state
    FROM retention_by_state_gender
    WHERE gender = 'F'
)
SELECT m.state
FROM males m
INNER JOIN females f ON m.state = f.state
ORDER BY m.state

    GROUP BY l.id_bioguide, l.gender, lt.state

years_interval AS (
    SELECT 0 as years_elapsed UNION ALL SELECT 2 UNION ALL SELECT 4 UNION ALL SELECT 6 UNION ALL SELECT 8 UNION ALL SELECT 10
),
legislator_check_dates AS (
    SELECT 
        lft.id_bioguide,
        lft.gender,
        lft.state,
        lft.first_term_start,
        y.years_elapsed,
        CAST(lft.first_term_start AS DATE) + INTERVAL '1 year' * y.years_elapsed as check_date
    FROM legislator_first_term lft
    CROSS JOIN years_interval y
),
legislator_serving AS (
    SELECT 
        lcd.id_bioguide,
        lcd.gender,
        lcd.state,
        lcd.years_elapsed,
        lcd.check_date,
        CASE 
            WHEN EXISTS (
                SELECT 1 FROM legislators_terms lt 
                WHERE lt.id_bioguide = lcd.id_bioguide 
                AND lt.state = lcd.state
                AND (CAST(t.term_start AS DATE) <= lcd.check_date AND CAST(t.term_end AS DATE) >= lcd.check_date)

            ELSE 0
        END as is_retained
    FROM legislator_check_dates lcd
    JOIN legislators_terms t ON lcd.id_bioguide = t.id_bioguide AND lcd.state = t.state
),
retention_rates AS (
    SELECT 
        state,
        gender,
        years_elapsed,
        SUM(is_retained) * 1.0 / COUNT(*) as retention_rate
    FROM legislator_serving
    GROUP BY state, gender, years_elapsed
)

local050.question: What is the median of the average monthly projected sales in USD for France in 2021, calculated by using the monthly sales data from 2019 and 2020 (filtered by promo_total_id=1 and channel_total_id=1), applying the growth rate from 2019 to 2020 to project 2021, converting to USD based on the currency table, and then determining the monthly averages before finding their median?
local050.doc:
## Projection Calculation Method

### Steps for Projection Calculation

1. **Aggregate Historical Sales Data**

   - **Data Collection**: Gather sales data for products sold in France, including sales amounts each month for the years 2019, 2020, and 2021.
   - **Summarize Sales**: Sum up the sales amounts for each product, country, month, and year.

2. **Calculate Average Sales**

   - **Monthly Averages**: Compute the average sales amount for each product and month across all available months to establish a baseline of typical sales.

3. **Project Sales for 2021**

   - **Identify Changes**: Determine how sales changed from 2019 to 2020 for each product and month. Calculate the percentage change in sales from 2019 to 2020.
   - **Apply Changes**: Use this percentage change to estimate the sales for each month in 2021.

   **Projection Formula**:
   - For 2021:
     - Calculate the difference in sales between 2020 and 2019.
     - Compute the percentage change relative to 2019 sales.
     - Apply this percentage change to the 2020 sales to estimate 2021 sales.
     - The formula used in the SQL query is:

       ```plaintext
       (((Sales in 2020 - Sales in 2019) / Sales in 2019) * Sales in 2020) + Sales in 2020
       ```

     - This formula calculates the projected sales for 2021 based on the observed trend from 2019 to 2020.

   - For other years (not 2021):
     - Use the average sales value calculated for each month.

4. **Adjust for Currency Conversion**

   - **Conversion Rates**: Convert the projected sales figures into USD using monthly conversion rates.
   - **Currency Adjustment**: Multiply the projected sales figures by the conversion rates to adjust to USD. If specific rates are not available, use a default rate of 1.

5. **Calculate Monthly Averages in USD**

   - **Monthly Projections**: Compute the average projected sales for each month in 2021, adjusting for currency conversion. Round the results to two decimal places.

6. **Compile Results**

   - **Organize Data**: Arrange the projected sales figures in a report, showing the estimated sales for each month in USD.

### Summary

The projection calculation involves analyzing historical sales data from 2019 and 2020 to determine trends, applying these trends to estimate sales for 2021, and adjusting for currency differences. The result is a forecast of monthly sales in USD for 2021.

candidates.sql:
WITH filtered_sales AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT
        s.time_id,
        t.calendar_year,
        t.calendar_month_number,
        cur.to_us as conversion_rate,
        s.amount_sold
    FROM sales s
    JOIN times t ON s.time_id = t.time_id
    JOIN countries co ON co.country_name = 'France'
    JOIN customers c ON c.country_id = co.country_id AND c.cust_valid = 'I'
    JOIN promotions p ON s.promo_id = p.promo_id AND p.promo_total_id = 1
    JOIN channels ch ON s.channel_id = ch.channel_id AND ch.channel_total_id = 1
    LEFT JOIN currency cur ON co.country_name = cur.country 
        AND t.calendar_year = cur.year
        AND t.calendar_month_number = cur.month
    WHERE t.calendar_year IN (2019, 2020)
),
monthly_sales AS (
    SELECT 
        calendar_year,
        calendar_month_number,
        SUM(amount_sold * conversion_rate) as monthly_total_usd
    FROM filtered_sales
    GROUP BY calendar_year, calendar_month_number
),
monthly_averages_2019 AS (
    SELECT 
        calendar_month_number,
        AVG(monthly_total_usd) as avg_2019
    FROM monthly_sales
    WHERE calendar_year = 2019
    GROUP BY calendar_month_number
),
monthly_averages_2020 AS (
    SELECT 
        calendar_month_number,
        AVG(monthly_total_usd) as avg_2020
    FROM monthly_sales
    WHERE calendar_year = 2020
    GROUP BY calendar_month_number
),
growth_rates AS (
    SELECT 
        ma2019.calendar_month_number,
        ((ma2020.avg_2020 - ma2019.avg_2019) / NULLIF(ma2019.avg_2019, 0)) as growth_rate
    FROM monthly_averages_2019 ma2019
    JOIN monthly_averages_2020 ma2020 ON ma2019.calendar_month_number = ma2020.calendar_month_number
),
projected_2021 AS (
    SELECT 
        gr.calendar_month_number,
        ma2020.avg_2020 * (1 + gr.growth_rate) as projected_monthly_sales_usd
    FROM growth_rates gr
    JOIN monthly_averages_2020 ma2020 ON gr.calendar_month_number = ma2020.calendar_month_number
)
SELECT MEDIAN(projected_monthly_sales_usd) as median_monthly_sales_usd FROM projected_2021;

WITH france_sales_2019 AS (
    SELECT 
        c.country_id,
        c.country_name,
        t.calendar_month_number,
        t.calendar_year,
        SUM(s.amount_sold) as total_sales
    FROM sales s
    JOIN customers cu ON s.cust_id = cu.cust_id
    JOIN countries c ON cu.country_id = c.country_id
    JOIN times t ON s.time_id = t.time_id
    WHERE c.country_name = 'France'
    AND c.country_id = 52779
    AND t.calendar_year = 2019
    AND s.channel_id IN (SELECT channel_id FROM channels WHERE channel_total_id = 1)
    AND s.promo_id IN (SELECT promo_id FROM promotions WHERE promo_total_id = 1)
    GROUP BY c.country_id, c.country_name, t.calendar_month_number, t.calendar_year
),
france_sales_2020 AS (
    SELECT 
        c.country_id,
        c.country_name,
        t.calendar_month_number,
        t.calendar_year,
        SUM(s.amount_sold) as total_sales
    FROM sales s
    JOIN customers cu ON s.cust_id = cu.cust_id
    JOIN countries c ON cu.country_id = c.country_id
    JOIN times t ON s.time_id = t.time_id
    WHERE c.country_name = 'France'
    AND c.country_id = 52779
    AND t.calendar_year = 2020
    AND s.channel_id IN (SELECT channel_id FROM channels WHERE channel_total_id = 1)
    AND s.promo_id IN (SELECT promo_id FROM promotions WHERE promo_total_id = 1)
    GROUP BY c.country_id, c.country_name, t.calendar_month_number, t.calendar_year
),
monthly_growth AS (
    SELECT 
        f2019.calendar_month_number,
        f2019.total_sales as sales_2019,
        f2020.total_sales as sales_2020,
        ((f2020.total_sales - f2019.total_sales) * 1.0 / f2019.total_sales) as growth_rate
    FROM france_sales_2019 f2019
    JOIN france_sales_2020 f2020 ON f2019.calendar_month_number = f2020.calendar_month_number
),
projected_2021 AS (
    SELECT 
        mg.calendar_month_number,
        ((mg.sales_2020 - mg.sales_2019) * 1.0 / mg.sales_2019) * mg.sales_2020 + mg.sales_2020 as projected_sales
    FROM monthly_growth mg
),
usd_converted AS (
    SELECT 
        p.calendar_month_number,
        p.projected_sales * COALESCE(c.to_us, 1.0) as projected_sales_usd
    FROM projected_2021 p
    LEFT JOIN currency c ON c.country = 'France' 
        AND c.year = 2021 
        AND c.month = p.calendar_month_number
)
SELECT 
    PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY projected_sales_usd) as median_monthly_projected_sales_usd
FROM usd_converted

WITH monthly_sales_2019 AS (
  SELECT 
    t.calendar_month_number as month_num,
    SUM(s.amount_sold) as sales_2019
  FROM sales s
  JOIN customers cu ON s.cust_id = cu.cust_id
  JOIN countries c ON cu.country_id = c.country_id
  JOIN times t ON s.time_id = t.time_id
  JOIN promotions p ON s.promo_id = p.promo_id
  WHERE c.country_name = 'France'
    AND s.channel_id IN (2,3,4,9)
    AND p.promo_total_id = 1
    AND t.calendar_year = 2019
    AND t.calendar_month_number BETWEEN 1 AND 12
  GROUP BY t.calendar_month_number
),
monthly_sales_2020 AS (
  SELECT 
    t.calendar_month_number as month_num,
    SUM(s.amount_sold) as sales_2020
  FROM sales s
  JOIN customers cu ON s.cust_id = cu.cust_id
  JOIN countries c ON cu.country_id = c.country_id
  JOIN times t ON s.time_id = t.time_id
  JOIN promotions p ON s.promo_id = p.promo_id
  WHERE c.country_name = 'France'
    AND s.channel_id IN (2,3,4,9)
    AND p.promo_total_id = 1
    AND t.calendar_year = 2020
    AND t.calendar_month_number BETWEEN 1 AND 12
  GROUP BY t.calendar_month_number
),
growth_calc AS (
  SELECT 
    m2020.month_num,
    m2020.sales_2020 as sales_2020,
    m2019.sales_2019 as sales_2019,
    m2020.sales_2020 * (m2020.sales_2020 / m2019.sales_2019) as projected_2021_raw
  FROM monthly_sales_2020 m2020
  JOIN monthly_sales_2019 m2019 ON m2020.month_num = m2019.month_num
),
projected_with_currency AS (
  SELECT 
    month_num,
    projected_2021_raw * COALESCE(currency.to_us, 1.0) as projected_2021_usd
  FROM growth_calc
  LEFT JOIN currency ON month_num = currency.month AND currency.country = 'France'
)
SELECT DISTINCT month_num, projected_2021_usd
FROM projected_with_currency
ORDER BY month_num

WITH q4_2019_city_sales AS (
    SELECT 
        c.cust_city_id,
        c.cust_city,
        SUM(s.amount_sold) as q4_2019_sales
    FROM sales s
    JOIN customers c ON s.cust_id = c.cust_id
    JOIN countries co ON c.country_id = co.country_id
    JOIN times t ON s.time_id = t.time_id
    WHERE co.country_name = 'United States of America'
        AND t.calendar_year = 2019
        AND t.calendar_quarter_number = 4
        AND s.promo_id IS NULL
    GROUP BY c.cust_city_id, c.cust_city
),
q4_2020_city_sales AS (
    SELECT 
        c.cust_city_id,
        c.cust_city,
        SUM(s.amount_sold) as q4_2020_sales
    FROM sales s
    JOIN customers c ON s.cust_id = c.cust_id
    JOIN countries co ON c.country_id = co.country_id
    JOIN times t ON s.time_id = t.time_id
    WHERE co.country_name = 'United States of America'
        AND t.calendar_year = 2020
        AND t.calendar_quarter_number = 4
        AND s.promo_id IS NULL
    GROUP BY c.cust_city_id, c.cust_city
),
city_growth AS (
    SELECT 
        q4_2019.cust_city_id,
        q4_2019.cust_city,
        q4_2019.q4_2019_sales,
        q4_2020.q4_2020_sales,
        CASE 
            WHEN q4_2019.q4_2019_sales > 0 THEN q4_2020.q4_2020_sales * 1.0 / q4_2019.q4_2019_sales
            ELSE 0 
        END as growth_ratio
    FROM q4_2019_city_sales q4_2019
    LEFT JOIN q4_2020_city_sales q4_2020 ON q4_2019.cust_city_id = q4_2020.cust_city_id
    WHERE q4_2020.q4_2020_sales IS NOT NULL
),
qualifying_cities AS (
    SELECT

        q4_2020_sales,
        growth_ratio

    JOIN countries co ON c.country_id = co.country_id
    JOIN times t ON s.time_id = t.time_id
    WHERE co.country_name = 'United States of America'

    FROM sales s
    JOIN customers c ON s.cust_id = c.cust_id
    JOIN countries co ON c.country_id = co.country_id
    JOIN times t ON s.time_id = t.time_id
    WHERE co.country_name = 'United States of America'

        t.calendar_year,

    JOIN times t ON s.time_id = t.time_id

    GROUP BY cust.cust_city, t.calendar_year
),
city_totals AS (
    SELECT

        calendar_year,
        SUM(total_sales) as city_total
    FROM city_sales
    GROUP BY cust_city, calendar_year
),
eligible_cities AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT ct1.cust_city
    FROM city_totals ct1
    JOIN city_totals ct2 ON ct1.cust_city = ct2.cust_city
    WHERE ct1.calendar_year = 2019
      AND ct2.calendar_year = 2020
      AND ct2.city_total >= ct1.city_total * 1.2
),
product_city_sales AS (
    SELECT 
        cust.cust_city,
        s.prod_id,
        t.calendar_year,
        SUM(s.amount_sold) as prod_sales
    FROM sales s
    JOIN customers cust ON s.cust_id = cust.cust_id
    JOIN countries c ON cust.country_id = c.country_id
    JOIN times t ON s.time_id = t.time_id
    WHERE c.country_id = 52790
      AND t.calendar_year IN (2019, 2020)
      AND t.calendar_quarter_number = 4
      AND s.promo_id = 999
      AND cust.cust_city IN (SELECT cust_city FROM eligible_cities)
    GROUP BY cust.cust_city, s.prod_id, t.calendar_year
),
product_city_totals AS (
    SELECT 
        cust_city,
        prod_id,
        SUM(prod_sales) as overall_sales
    FROM product_city_sales
    GROUP BY cust_city, prod_id
),
ranked_products AS (

        cust_city,
        prod_id,
        overall_sales,

),
top_20_percent_products AS (

local061.question: What is the average projected monthly sales in USD for France in 2021, considering only product sales with promotions where promo_total_id = 1 and channels where channel_total_id = 1, by taking each product’s monthly sales from 2019 and 2020, calculating the growth rate from 2019 to 2020 for that same product and month, applying this growth rate to project 2021 monthly sales, converting all projected 2021 amounts to USD with the 2021 exchange rates, and finally averaging and listing them by month?
local061.doc:
## Projection Calculation Method

### Steps for Projection Calculation

1. **Aggregate Historical Sales Data**

   - **Data Collection**: Gather sales data for products sold in France, including sales amounts each month for the years 2019, 2020, and 2021.
   - **Summarize Sales**: Sum up the sales amounts for each product, country, month, and year.

2. **Calculate Average Sales**

   - **Monthly Averages**: Compute the average sales amount for each product and month across all available months to establish a baseline of typical sales.

3. **Project Sales for 2021**

   - **Identify Changes**: Determine how sales changed from 2019 to 2020 for each product and month. Calculate the percentage change in sales from 2019 to 2020.
   - **Apply Changes**: Use this percentage change to estimate the sales for each month in 2021.

   **Projection Formula**:
   - For 2021:
     - Calculate the difference in sales between 2020 and 2019.
     - Compute the percentage change relative to 2019 sales.
     - Apply this percentage change to the 2020 sales to estimate 2021 sales.
     - The formula used in the SQL query is:

       ```plaintext
       (((Sales in 2020 - Sales in 2019) / Sales in 2019) * Sales in 2020) + Sales in 2020
       ```

     - This formula calculates the projected sales for 2021 based on the observed trend from 2019 to 2020.

   - For other years (not 2021):
     - Use the average sales value calculated for each month.

4. **Adjust for Currency Conversion**

   - **Conversion Rates**: Convert the projected sales figures into USD using monthly conversion rates.
   - **Currency Adjustment**: Multiply the projected sales figures by the conversion rates to adjust to USD. If specific rates are not available, use a default rate of 1.

5. **Calculate Monthly Averages in USD**

   - **Monthly Projections**: Compute the average projected sales for each month in 2021, adjusting for currency conversion. Round the results to two decimal places.

6. **Compile Results**

   - **Organize Data**: Arrange the projected sales figures in a report, showing the estimated sales for each month in USD.

### Summary

The projection calculation involves analyzing historical sales data from 2019 and 2020 to determine trends, applying these trends to estimate sales for 2021, and adjusting for currency differences. The result is a forecast of monthly sales in USD for 2021.

        s.prod_id,
        t.calendar_month_number,
        SUM(s.amount_sold) as monthly_sales_2019
    FROM sales s
    JOIN customers cu ON s.cust_id = cu.cust_id
    JOIN countries c ON cu.country_id = c.country_id
    JOIN times t ON s.time_id = t.time_id
    WHERE c.country_name = 'France'
    AND s.channel_id IN (SELECT channel_id FROM channels WHERE channel_total_id = 1)
    AND s.promo_id IN (SELECT promo_id FROM promotions WHERE promo_total_id = 1)
    AND t.calendar_year = 2019
    GROUP BY s.prod_id, t.calendar_month_number
),
sales_2020 AS (
    SELECT 
        s.prod_id,
        t.calendar_month_number,
        SUM(s.amount_sold) as monthly_sales_2020
    FROM sales s
    JOIN customers cu ON s.cust_id = cu.cust_id
    JOIN countries c ON cu.country_id = c.country_id
    JOIN times t ON s.time_id = t.time_id
    WHERE c.country_name = 'France'
    AND s.channel_id IN (SELECT channel_id FROM channels WHERE channel_total_id = 1)
    AND s.promo_id IN (SELECT promo_id FROM promotions WHERE promo_total_id = 1)
    AND t.calendar_year = 2020
    GROUP BY s.prod_id, t.calendar_month_number
),
growth_rates AS (
    SELECT 
        s2019.prod_id,
        s2019.calendar_month_number,
        ((s2020.monthly_sales_2020 - s2019.monthly_sales_2019) / NULLIF(s2019.monthly_sales_2019, 0)) as growth_rate
    FROM sales_2019 s2019
    JOIN sales_2020 s2020 ON s2019.prod_id = s2020.prod_id AND s2019.calendar_month_number = s2020.calendar_month_number
),
projected_2021 AS (
    SELECT 
        g.prod_id,
        g.calendar_month_number,
        (g.growth_rate * s2020.monthly_sales_2020) + s2020.monthly_sales_2020 as projected_2021_sales
    FROM growth_rates g
    JOIN sales_2020 s2020 ON g.prod_id = s2020.prod_id AND g.calendar_month_number = s2020.calendar_month_number
),
monthly_avg_2021 AS (
    SELECT 
        t.calendar_month_number,
        SUM(cur.to_us) as exchange_rate,
        AVG(p.projected_2021_sales * cur.to_us) as avg_projected_sales_usd
    FROM projected_2021 p
    JOIN times t ON p.calendar_month_number = t.calendar_month_number
    JOIN currency cur ON cur.country = 'France' AND cur.year = 2021 AND cur.month = t.calendar_month_number
    GROUP BY t.calendar_month_number
)
SELECT * FROM monthly_avg_2021 ORDER BY calendar_month_number

WITH sales_2019 AS (
    SELECT 
        s.prod_id,
        t.calendar_month_number,
        SUM(s.amount_sold) as monthly_sales_2019
    FROM sales s
    JOIN customers cu ON s.cust_id = cu.cust_id
    JOIN countries c ON cu.country_id = c.country_id
    JOIN times t ON s.time_id = t.time_id
    WHERE c.country_name = 'France'
    AND s.channel_id IN (SELECT channel_id FROM channels WHERE channel_total_id = 1)
    AND s.promo_id IN (SELECT promo_id FROM promotions WHERE promo_total_id = 1)
    AND t.calendar_year = 2019
    GROUP BY s.prod_id, t.calendar_month_number
),
sales_2020 AS (
    SELECT 
        s.prod_id,
        t.calendar_month_number,
        SUM(s.amount_sold) as monthly_sales_2020
    FROM sales s
    JOIN customers cu ON s.cust_id = cu.cust_id
    JOIN countries c ON cu.country_id = c.country_id
    JOIN times t ON s.time_id = t.time_id
    WHERE c.country_name = 'France'
    AND s.channel_id IN (SELECT channel_id FROM channels WHERE channel_total_id = 1)
    AND s.promo_id IN (SELECT promo_id FROM promotions WHERE promo_total_id = 1)
    AND t.calendar_year = 2020
    GROUP BY s.prod_id, t.calendar_month_number
),
growth_rates AS (
    SELECT 
        s2019.prod_id,
        s2019.calendar_month_number,
        ((s2020.monthly_sales_2020 - s2019.monthly_sales_2019) / NULLIF(s2019.monthly_sales_2019, 0)) as growth_rate
    FROM sales_2019 s2019
    JOIN sales_2020 s2020 ON s2019.prod_id = s2020.prod_id AND s2019.calendar_month_number = s2020.calendar_month_number
),
projected_2021 AS (
    SELECT 
        g.prod_id,
        g.calendar_month_number,
        (g.growth_rate * s2020.monthly_sales_2020) + s2020.monthly_sales_2020 as projected_2021_sales
    FROM growth_rates g
    JOIN sales_2020 s2020 ON g.prod_id = s2020.prod_id AND g.calendar_month_number = s2020.calendar_month_number
),
projected_with_currency AS (
    SELECT 
        p.prod_id,
        p.calendar_month_number,
        p.projected_2021_sales * c.to_us as projected_2021_usd
    FROM projected_2021 p
    JOIN currency c ON c.country = 'France' AND c.year = 2021 AND c.month = p.calendar_month_number
)
SELECT calendar_month_number, AVG(projected_2021_usd) as avg_projected_monthly_sales_usd
FROM projected_with_currency
GROUP BY calendar_month_number
ORDER BY calendar_month_number

),

    FROM product_month_sales a

WITH historical_sales AS (
    SELECT 
        s.prod_id,
        t.calendar_month_number,
        t.calendar_year,
        SUM(s.amount_sold) as monthly_sales
    FROM sales s
    JOIN customers cu ON cu.cust_id = s.cust_id
    JOIN countries c ON c.country_id = cu.country_id
    JOIN times t ON t.time_id = s.time_id
    JOIN channels ch ON ch.channel_id = s.channel_id
    JOIN promotions p ON p.promo_id = s.promo_id
    WHERE c.country_name = 'France'
      AND c.country_total_id = 52806
      AND ch.channel_total_id = 1
      AND p.promo_total_id = 1
      AND t.calendar_year IN (2019, 2020, 2021)
    GROUP BY s.prod_id, t.calendar_month_number, t.calendar_year
),
sales_with_growth AS (
    SELECT 
        prod_id,
        calendar_month_number,
        monthly_sales,
        calendar_year,
        CASE WHEN LAG(monthly_sales) OVER (PARTITION BY prod_id, calendar_month_number ORDER BY calendar_year) IS NOT NULL
             THEN (monthly_sales - LAG(monthly_sales) OVER (PARTITION BY prod_id, calendar_month_number ORDER BY calendar_year)) 
                  / LAG(monthly_sales) OVER (PARTITION BY prod_id, calendar_month_number ORDER BY calendar_year)
             ELSE 0 
        END as growth_rate
    FROM historical_sales
    WHERE calendar_year = 2020
),
projected_2021 AS (
    SELECT 
        prod_id,
        calendar_month_number,
        monthly_sales AS sales_2020,
        growth_rate,
        (growth_rate * monthly_sales) + monthly_sales AS projected_2021
    FROM sales_with_growth
),
final_calc AS (
    SELECT 
        p.prod_id,
        p.calendar_month_number,
        p.projected_2021,
        c.to_us,
        p.projected_2021 * c.to_us AS projected_2021_usd
    FROM projected_2021 p
    JOIN currency c ON c.country = 'France' AND c.year = 2021 AND c.month = p.calendar_month_number
)
SELECT 
    calendar_month_number,
    ROUND(AVG(projected_2021_usd), 2) AS avg_projected_monthly_sales_usd
FROM final_calc
GROUP BY calendar_month_number
ORDER BY calendar_month_number

  JOIN customers c ON s.cust_id = c.cust_id

  WHERE s.promo_id = 999
    AND c.country_id = 52790
    AND t.calendar_quarter_id IN (1772, 1776)
  GROUP BY c.cust_city
  HAVING SUM(CASE WHEN t.calendar_quarter_id = 1772 THEN s.amount_sold ELSE 0 END) > 0
     AND (SUM(CASE WHEN t.calendar_quarter_id = 1776 THEN s.amount_sold ELSE 0 END) -

),
product_ranked AS (

        total_prod_sales,

    FROM product_total_sales
),
top_20_percent_products AS (
    SELECT prod_id, total_prod_sales FROM product_ranked WHERE sales_percentile = 1
),
q4_2019_totals AS (
    SELECT prod_id, SUM(prod_sales) as prod_sales_q4_2019
    FROM product_quarter_sales
    WHERE calendar_quarter_id = 1772
    GROUP BY prod_id
),
q4_2020_totals AS (
    SELECT prod_id, SUM(prod_sales) as prod_sales_q4_2020
    FROM product_quarter_sales
    WHERE calendar_quarter_id = 1776

    WHERE calendar_quarter_id = 1776

),

WITH city_sales AS (
  SELECT c.cust_city, c.cust_city_id, t.calendar_quarter_id,
         SUM(s.amount_sold) as total_sales
  FROM sales s
  JOIN customers c ON s.cust_id = c.cust_id
  JOIN times t ON s.time_id = t.time_id
  JOIN countries co ON c.country_id = co.country_id
  WHERE co.country_id = 52790
    AND s.promo_id = 999
    AND t.calendar_quarter_id IN (1772, 1776)
  GROUP BY c.cust_city, c.cust_city_id, t.calendar_quarter_id
),
city_growth AS (
  SELECT cust_city, cust_city_id,
         SUM(CASE WHEN calendar_quarter_id = 1772 THEN total_sales ELSE 0 END) as q4_2019_sales,
         SUM(CASE WHEN calendar_quarter_id = 1776 THEN total_sales ELSE 0 END) as q4_2020_sales
  FROM city_sales
  GROUP BY cust_city, cust_city_id
  HAVING SUM(CASE WHEN calendar_quarter_id = 1772 THEN total_sales ELSE 0 END) > 0
),
qualifying_cities AS (
  SELECT cust_city_id
  FROM city_growth
  WHERE 100.0 * (q4_2020_sales - q4_2019_sales) / q4_2019_sales >= 20
),
prod_city_sales AS (
  SELECT s.prod_id, c.cust_city_id, t.calendar_quarter_id, SUM(s.amount_sold) as prod_sales
  FROM sales s
  JOIN customers c ON s.cust_id = c.cust_id
  JOIN times t ON s.time_id = t.time_id
  WHERE c.country_id = 52790
    AND s.promo_id = 999
    AND t.calendar_quarter_id IN (1772, 1776)
    AND c.cust_city_id IN (SELECT cust_city_id FROM qualifying_cities)
  GROUP BY s.prod_id, c.cust_city_id, t.calendar_quarter_id
),
prod_quarter_sales AS (
  SELECT prod_id, calendar_quarter_id, SUM(prod_sales) as quarter_sales
  FROM prod_city_sales
  GROUP BY prod_id, calendar_quarter_id
),
prod_total AS (
  SELECT prod_id,
         SUM(CASE WHEN calendar_quarter_id = 1772 THEN quarter_sales ELSE 0 END) as q4_2019_sales,
         SUM(CASE WHEN calendar_quarter_id = 1776 THEN quarter_sales ELSE 0 END) as q4_2020_sales,
         SUM(quarter_sales) as total_sales
  FROM prod_quarter_sales
  GROUP BY prod_id
),
prod_share AS (
  SELECT prod_id,
         q4_2019_sales,
         q4_2020_sales,
         total_sales,
         100.0 * q4_2019_sales / (q4_2019_sales + q4_2020_sales) as q4_2019_share,
         100.0 * q4_2020_sales / (q4_2019_sales + q4_2020_sales) as q4_2020_share,
         100.0 * (q4_2020_sales - q4_2019_sales) / (q4_2019_sales + q4_2020_sales) as share_change_pp
  FROM prod_total
),
ranked_products AS (
  SELECT prod_id, total_sales, share_change_pp,
         NTILE(5) OVER (ORDER BY total_sales DESC) as quintile
  FROM prod_share
)
SELECT prod_id, total_sales, share_change_pp, quintile
FROM ranked_products
WHERE quintile = 1  -- top 20%
ORDER BY share_change_pp ASC
LIMIT 20

local286.question: Prepare a comprehensive performance report on our sellers, focusing on total sales, average item price, average review scores, and packing times. Ensure that the report includes only those sellers who have sold a quantity of more than 100 products and highlight the product category names in English with the highest sales volume.

candidates.sql:
WITH seller_sales AS (
  SELECT 
    seller_id,
    COUNT(*) as total_quantity,
    AVG(price) as avg_item_price
  FROM order_items
  GROUP BY seller_id
  HAVING COUNT(*) > 100
),
seller_reviews AS (
  SELECT 
    oi.seller_id,
    AVG(oc.review_score) as avg_review_score
  FROM order_items oi
  JOIN orders o ON oi.order_id = o.order_id
  JOIN order_reviews oc ON o.order_id = oc.order_id
  GROUP BY oi.seller_id
),
seller_packing AS (
  SELECT 
    oi.seller_id,
    AVG((CAST(oi.shipping_limit_date AS DATE) - CAST(o.order_purchase_timestamp AS DATE)) * 24.0) as avg_packing_days
  FROM order_items oi
  JOIN orders o ON oi.order_id = o.order_id
  GROUP BY oi.seller_id
),
top_categories AS (
  SELECT 
    pcat.product_category_name_english,
    SUM(oi.price) as category_sales_volume
  FROM order_items oi
  JOIN products p ON oi.product_id = p.product_id
  JOIN product_category_name_translation pcat ON p.product_category_name = pcat.product_category_name
  GROUP BY pcat.product_category_name_english
  ORDER BY category_sales_volume DESC
  LIMIT 1
)
SELECT 
  ss.seller_id,
  ss.total_quantity,
  ss.avg_item_price,
  CASE WHEN sr.avg_review_score IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE sr.avg_review_score END as avg_review_score,
  CASE WHEN sp.avg_packing_days IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE sp.avg_packing_days END as avg_packing_days,
  tc.product_category_name_english as top_category_english
FROM seller_sales ss
LEFT JOIN seller_reviews sr ON ss.seller_id = sr.seller_id
LEFT JOIN seller_packing sp ON ss.seller_id = sp.seller_id
CROSS JOIN top_categories tc
ORDER BY ss.total_quantity DESC

    SELECT 
        s.seller_id,
        SUM(oi.price) as total_sales,
        AVG(oi.price) as avg_item_price,
        COUNT(oi.order_item_id) as quantity_sold
    FROM sellers s

    GROUP BY s.seller_id
    HAVING COUNT(oi.order_item_id) > 100
),
